title: 0xNull Hub V2
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Create ScreenGui
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
gui.Name = "0xNullHub"

-- Main Frame
local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 300)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -150)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)

-- Title
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.Text = "0xNull Hub | by 0xNull"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1

-- Example Button Function
local function createButton(text, posY, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 30)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, posY)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- Add Options (expand to 30+)
createButton("Speed Boost", 50, function()
    player.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 50
end)

createButton("Reset Speed", 90, function()
    player.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
end)

createButton("Jump Boost", 130, function()
    player.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 100
end)

createButton("Reset Jump", 170, function()
    player.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
end)

-- You can duplicate createButton to reach 30+ options

comments.text: This only makes u faster and jump higher for the people who dont know 🤙
